name: page-wipe-transition
title: Page Wipe Transition
description: A full-bleed panel wipes across the viewport in two phases — an entering panel covers with an accelerated ease, the new content is swapped beneath it, then the panel exits slower with deceleration, mimicking an editor's cut.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Brutalist
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Navigate Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
